title: Hodge--Tate splitting and Akizuki--Nakano vanishing in positive characteristic
summary: We introduce the notion of Hodge--Tate splitting for schemes in positive characteristic. For a smooth variety $X$ over a perfect field $k$ of characteristic $p > 0$, we say that $X$ is Hodge--Tate split if the natural morphism $\mathcal{O}_X \to F_*Ω^\bullet_{X/k}$ induced by the absolute Frobenius admits a splitting in $\mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{qcoh}}(X)$. We prove that this condition is equivalent to the existence of a decomposition $F_*Ω^\bullet_{X/k} \simeq \bigoplus_{i=0}^{\dim X}Ω^i_{X/k}[-i]$ of its de Rham complex.
